title: Road Trip
blurb: Long drives, servo snacks, wrong turns and who controls the music.

questions.text: Who would be most likely to fall asleep before we even leave the driveway?
Who is most likely to take control of the music and never give it back?
Who at this table would be the worst navigator?
Who would be most likely to need a toilet stop every half hour?
Who would eat all the snacks in the first hour?
Who among us is most likely to insist on a scenic detour that adds three hours?
Who would be most likely to forget to fill up and run out of fuel?
Who do you reckon is most likely to sing every word of every song in the car?
Who's the one most likely to bring way too much luggage for a weekend away?
Who would be most likely to start a car game nobody else wants to play?
Who at this table would be the calmest driver in heavy traffic?
Who is most likely to stop at every giant roadside statue?
Who would be most likely to lock the keys in the car?
Who would complain about the temperature the entire way?
Who among us is most likely to get carsick and blame the driver?
Who would be most likely to make friends with the locals at a country pub?
Who do you reckon is most likely to plan every single stop on a spreadsheet?
Who's the one most likely to ask "are we there yet" as a fully grown adult?
Who at this table would be the first to volunteer to drive and the first to ask to swap?
Who would be most likely to take a hundred photos of the same view?
Who is most likely to leave something important at the last servo?
Who would be most likely to talk the whole drive without taking a breath?
Who would change the destination halfway there?
Who among us is most likely to bring a guitar and insist on a campfire singalong?
Who would be most likely to pitch a tent upside down?
Who do you reckon is most likely to get everyone lost because they "know a shortcut"?
Who's the one most likely to sleep in the car rather than set up a tent?
Who would be most likely to keep a travel diary of the whole trip?
Who at this table would be the worst person to share a motel room with?
Who is most likely to start a fight over the aircon?
Who would be most likely to buy a novelty souvenir at every single stop?
Who would pack nothing but snacks and one spare shirt?
Who among us is most likely to demand a stop at a roadside fruit stall and buy twelve kilos of mangoes?
Who would be most likely to hold the map upside down and defend it?
Who do you reckon is most likely to wake up at the back of the van asking where we are, every hour?
Who's the one most likely to pick a campsite right next to the toilet block?
Who would be most likely to start a very serious debate about the best servo pie?
Who is most likely to hog the only phone charger?
Who would be most likely to stop the car to rescue a stray animal?
Who would last longest on a trip with no phone signal?
Who would buy a bumper sticker that says something unfortunate?
Who has the worst taste in road trip playlists?
Who among us is most likely to forget the tent pegs but pack three kinds of hot sauce?
Who would be most likely to get a puncture and say "I've never changed a tyre"?
Who do you reckon is most likely to read every tourist info sign out loud?
Who's the one most likely to leave a campsite looking like a festival ground?
Who would be most likely to have a holiday fling on a road trip?
Who is most likely to sneak someone into a motel room?
Who would be most likely to flirt with the person behind the servo counter?
